name: Orendil's Cure
summary: Orendil's Cure is an urgent delivery errand tasked to Alliance travelers by the herbalist Orendil Broadleaf. After concocting a remedy from rare flora, Orendil sends the courier racing down the woodland roads to Astranaar to save a dying night elf child.

sections.title: A Father's Despair
sections.body: In the central settlement of Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon watches over his daughter, Relara, as she wastes away from a severe and mysterious sickness. Facing the limits of local knowledge, Pelturas sought aid across the wild forest of Ashenvale, turning to the wisdom of distant herbalists before hope slipped entirely through his fingers.

sections.title: A Race Across the Woodlands
sections.body: Having successfully procured the necessary components—specifically Bathran's hair—Orendil Broadleaf brews a specialized draught capable of halting the affliction. Entrusting the fragile cure to a passing adventurer, Orendil directs them south and east along the beaten forest highway to deliver the flask before it is too late.

sections.title: A Fragile Respite
sections.body: While Orendil's draught provides much-needed relief to Relara, the herbal remedy is not a permanent solution for the supernatural malignancy gnawing at her spirit. Delivering the potion buys vital time, opening a broader search across ancient Kaldorei ruins for consecrated relics blessed by Elune to complete her salvation.

faq.answer: Relara Whitemoon, the young daughter of Pelturas Whitemoon, is lying bedridden in Astranaar. Her condition is critical, leaving her father desperate for any remedy to stay her decline.
Orendil Broadleaf, a skilled night elf herbalist stationed in northern Ashenvale, prepared the mixture after receiving plant matter collected from Bathran's Haunt.

Pelturas Whitemoon resides in Astranaar, the primary Alliance town nestled along the main road in central Ashenvale. He can be found watching over his daughter's sickbed inside one of the woodland dwellings.

faq.q: Does Orendil's Cure completely heal Relara?
faq.answer: No. While the herbal draught successfully stabilizes Relara's immediate condition and offers her father renewed hope, her sickness requires deeper spiritual intervention that sends travelers searching for Elune's Tear.

faq.q: What ingredients were used to create this cure?
faq.answer: The primary ingredient was Bathran's hair, a rare and potent plant gathered from the cursed ground of Bathran's Haunt north of Maestra's Post.

faq.q: Why didn't Astranaar's local healers brew the cure themselves?
faq.answer: Relara's affliction proved resistant to Astranaar's everyday remedies, prompting Pelturas to call upon the specialized botanical expertise of Orendil Broadleaf, who knows how to handle the potent flora found in northern Ashenvale.

angles.text: The delivery demonstrates the critical line between raw botany and battlefield medicine, highlighting how harvested Ashenvale herbs like Bathran's hair can hold a child's life in the balance.
For the Kaldorei, protecting Astranaar means safeguarding its young; assisting Pelturas and Relara touches the heart of night elf community survival in a contested forest.
While herbs provide temporary physical relief for Relara, the lingering malady soon demands the sacred intervention and lunar rites of Elune.
